records.title: Cemetery of Polish Army soldiers who died in the battle of Tomaszów Lubelski on September 23, 1939 in Antoniówka (17).jpg
records.originalTitle: Cemetery of Polish Army soldiers who died in the battle of Tomaszów Lubelski on September 23, 1939 in Antoniówka (17).jpg
records.summary: Grave. Captain of the Polish Army, Ignacy Spirydowicz. Cemetery of fallen soldiers of the Polish Army in the battle of Tomaszów Lubelski on September 23, 1939, in Antoniówka in the Zamość region near Tomaszów Lubelski. Cemetery of fallen soldiers of the Polish Army in the fight against the German Nazi invaders in the Polish Defense War in September 1939 during World War II. The cemetery is located in Antoniówka. On the road from Zamość to Tomaszów Lubelski - in Budy - turn right. And then, in the village of Antoniówka, on the left side of the road, there is a cemetery of the Polish Army Soldiers who died in the Battle of Tomaszów Lubelski on September 23, 1939. A narrow path leads to it. Almost in front of the last house in this town. Almost 500 (five hundred) soldiers of the Polish Army who died in September 1939 in the Polish Defense War in the Second Battle of Tomaszów Lubelski during World War II are buried in the cemetery.
topics: Cemetery of Polish Army soldiers who died in the battle of Tomaszów Lubelski on September 23, 1939 in Antoniówka

records.originalTitle: Cemetery of Polish Army soldiers who died in the battle of Tomaszów Lubelski on September 23, 1939 in Antoniówka (31).jpg
records.summary: Cemetery of fallen soldiers of the Polish Army in the battle of Tomaszów Lubelski on September 23, 1939, in Antoniówka in the Zamość region near Tomaszów Lubelski. Cemetery of fallen soldiers of the Polish Army in the fight against the German Nazi invaders in the Polish Defense War in September 1939 during World War II. The cemetery is located in Antoniówka. On the road from Zamość to Tomaszów Lubelski - in Budy - turn right. And then, in the village of Antoniówka, on the left side of the road, there is a cemetery of the Polish Army Soldiers who died in the Battle of Tomaszów Lubelski on September 23, 1939. A narrow path leads to it. Almost in front of the last house in this town. Almost 500 (five hundred) soldiers of the Polish Army who died in September 1939 in the Polish Defense War in the Second Battle of Tomaszów Lubelski during World War II are buried in the cemetery.

records.originalTitle: Cemetery of Polish Army soldiers who died in the battle of Tomaszów Lubelski on September 23, 1939 in Antoniówka (33).jpg
records.summary: Plaque with the names of the fallen Polish soldiers. Cemetery of fallen soldiers of the Polish Army in the battle of Tomaszów Lubelski on September 23, 1939, in Antoniówka in the Zamość region near Tomaszów Lubelski. Cemetery of fallen soldiers of the Polish Army in the fight against the German Nazi invaders in the Polish Defense War in September 1939 during World War II. The cemetery is located in Antoniówka. On the road from Zamość to Tomaszów Lubelski - in Budy - turn right. And then, in the village of Antoniówka, on the left side of the road, there is a cemetery of the Polish Army Soldiers who died in the Battle of Tomaszów Lubelski on September 23, 1939. A narrow path leads to it. Almost in front of the last house in this town. Almost 500 (five hundred) soldiers of the Polish Army who died in September 1939 in the Polish Defense War in the Second Battle of Tomaszów Lubelski during World War II are buried in the cemetery.
topics: Cemetery of Polish Army soldiers who died in the battle of Tomaszów Lubelski on September 23, 1939 in Antoniówka
